subject: general
question: The Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Amendment Bill, 2022 belongs to _____ Ministry of Indian Government.
solution:
The correct answer is __**External Affairs.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 3, i.e., External Affairs Ministry of Indian Government.**
 
• The Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Amendment Bill, 2022 **aims to regulate and prohibit unlawful activities related to weapons of mass destruction and their delivery systems.**
 
• The bill seeks to strengthen** India's compliance with international norms** and obligations related to non-proliferation and disarmament.
 
• The bill will also help in preventing the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction to non-state actors or terrorist organizations.
 
• Finance Ministry is responsible for managing the financial resources of the government, Civil Aviation Ministry is responsible for the administration of civil aviation in India, and Defence Ministry is responsible for the defence of India's borders and sovereignty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD) refers to chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear weapons that have the potential to cause mass destruction and loss of life**.
 
• The use, development, and proliferation of WMD is a major threat to global peace and security.
 
• The External Affairs Ministry is responsible for India's foreign relations, including its engagement with international organizations and forums related to disarmament, non-proliferation, and arms control.
 
• The Finance Ministry is responsible for managing the financial resources of the government, including budgeting and taxation.
 
• The Civil Aviation Ministry is responsible for the administration of civil aviation in India, including the regulation of air transport services and airport infrastructure.
